title: github-copilot-cli hook stdin contract
description: Seam 3 of the adapter's invocation plumbing: the camelCase hook input the Copilot CLI runtime (and the GitHub Copilot app that embeds it) writes to a command hook's stdin. Grounded in https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference and in payloads captured from the GitHub Copilot app on Windows (runtime 1.0.102), which are authoritative where they differ: preToolUse is BATCHED (`toolCalls`), postToolUse/postToolUseFailure carry `toolName`/`toolArgs`, and inside a subagent every event's `sessionId` is the subagent's `agentId`. Deliberately permissive (unknown fields allowed): the runtime adds fields between releases and the adapter reads only the keys tools.yaml names, failing closed on a tool-call shape it cannot read.

sessionId.description: The host session — inside a subagent, the subagent's agentId.

cwd.description: The working directory of the session (absolute; a Windows path on Windows).

timestamp.description: Event time (epoch milliseconds in the observed runtime). Absent on preToolUse.

agentId.description: subagentStart/subagentStop: the subagent's id; inside a subagent: its own id.

agentType.description: The custom agent's name (the `task` tool's agent_type).

parentAgentId.description: The dispatching session's id, on subagent events and inside a subagent.

toolCalls.description: preToolUse (observed): every tool call of the batch the model issued.

toolName.description: postToolUse/postToolUseFailure (and the documented single-call preToolUse shape).

toolArgs.description: The tool's arguments — an object, or (documented shape) a JSON-encoded string.

transformedPrompt.description: userPromptTransformed: the model-facing prompt the hook may replace.
